jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Manage New Product Development Programs from Concept to Launch

Fieldpiece
is the innovation leader in professional HVACR test instruments, trusted by technicians around the world to solve some of the industry's toughest challenges. We're investing heavily in the future of product development through modern methodologies, connected products, AI-enabled engineering, and customer-centered innovation. Named one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years
, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact.

Why This Role?

Great products don't happen by accident - they happen because exceptional leaders bring people, ideas, and execution together.

As the Senior Program Manager
, you'll lead some of Fieldpiece's most strategic new product initiatives while helping transform how we develop products. You'll work across Engineering, Product Management, Industrial Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and global development partners to align teams, remove obstacles, and deliver innovative connected products.

Beyond delivering successful programs, you'll play a key role in advancing our FTTM methodology, helping us continuously improve how we innovate, collaborate, and bring products to market. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, influencing without authority, and turning ambitious ideas into reality, you'll thrive in this role.

This position is in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028.
This role follows a hybrid work schedule
, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.

What You'll Do

Lead multiple, complex new product development programs from concept through commercial launch that include hardware, firmware, and software.
Align cross-functional teams across Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, Quality, Operations, and Manufacturing.
Drive program planning, risk management, executive communication, and decision-making.
Coordinate global development activities with suppliers and strategic partners.
Champion Fast Time To Market (FTTM) methodologies and continuous improvement.
Help build a culture of accountability, transparency, and excellence in execution.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

You'll help redefine how an entire company develops products while bringing innovative connected technologies to market faster than ever before.
Shape the future of product development at an innovation-driven company building the next-generation of connected HVACR products by applying FTTM methodologies to accelerate innovation.
Influence both what we build to solve real customer problems and how we build them.
Help drive the adoption of AI-enabled engineering, connected products, and technician productivity solutions in collaboration with global engineering organizations and strategic technology partners.

In Your First Year, You'll Likely Have

Successfully lead multiple new product development programs through key development milestones.
Become a trusted cross-functional leader who helps teams make better, faster decisions.
Embedded FTTM best practices into day-to-day program execution.
Built strong relationships with internal teams and strategic external partners.
Improved program visibility, risk management, and execution predictability.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related STEM field.
10+ years of program and/or project management experience leading complex new product development initiatives in engineering or manufacturing environments.
A proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects and integrated product programs, aligning cross-functional teams to deliver on schedule.
Experience leading hardware, firmware, and software product development programs from concept through launch.
Strong understanding of the product development lifecycle, including both hardware development and software development processes.
Experience working with global suppliers, ODMs, contract manufacturers, and overseas manufacturing partners.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools, including Microsoft Office and modern project tracking software.

Bonus Points If You Have

Experience establishing or improving project governance, stage-gate reviews, PMO structures, or organizational change within a growing or rapidly scaling company.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or Microsoft Project.
Professional certifications such as PMP, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, or similar.
Experience helping organizations improve program execution through modern product development methodologies.

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece

As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short-term results.
Work alongside talented, collaborative teammates who are passionate about innovation and solving real world problems.
Make a meaningful impact in a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business.

Benefits & Perks

We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well-being, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting
Generous paid time off and paid holidays
Hire to Retire philosophy - Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Music program – music rooms in all US offices with onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California (classes can be streamed for other offices)
Recognition programs, launch parties and team building events to share successes

Our Culture

At Fieldpiece, Our Values Shape How We Work, Collaborate, And Serve Our Customers Every Day. We Use The TURTL Acronym To Show That We Believe In

TRIBE – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team.
Upfront Homework – We come prepared, begin with the end in mind and address obstacles with creativity, grit and tenacity.
Right Stuff – We deliver innovative solutions by seeing through the eyes of our customers and use purposeful critical thinking to lead to greatness.
Trust – We build strong relationships through credibility, accountability and transparency.
Lean – We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, learning from failures and delivering results.
No Ego – We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect.

jobs.title: Information System Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Position Is Contingent Upon Award**

Peraton Labs is hiring an Information System Security Manager (ISSM) to be the single point of contact to Covered California and the accountable owner of oversight, timely execution, and quality for every security service Peraton delivers to the California health benefit exchange and the CalHEERS eligibility and enrollment system. You will lead a small, senior, multi-disciplinary security team spanning governance and compliance, security architecture and engineering, incident response, third-party risk, technical security, monitoring, and data protection.

You will work directly with Covered California's CISO and Information Security Officer, technical and project teams, business stakeholders, and independent assessors. The goal is to keep a system that carries the personal, health, and financial information of millions of Californians measurably secure, continuously compliant with NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, ARC-AMPE, and IRS Publication 1075, and ready for CMS Authority to Connect review.

What You Will Do In This Role:

Lead the security team. Manage and coordinate the day-to-day activities of assigned information security personnel; provide leadership, mentoring, and direction, and own deliverable accuracy, consistency, and schedule adherence across all seven contracted service areas.
Serve as the primary client security liaison. Act as the single operational point of contact among contractor personnel, Covered California security leadership, technical teams, project teams, and business stakeholders, and deliver regular status, risk, and escalation reporting to security leadership.
Own the compliance and GRC engine. Manage security activities tied to NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls; coordinate development and review of security policies, procedures, standards, and plans; direct GRC activities and platforms; and maintain the risk register.
Drive risk down to closure. Oversee risk assessments, control reviews, gap analyses, and remediation; track weaknesses, findings, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) through verified closure.
Serve as backup incident manager. Support the incident response program in coordination with the client Information Security Officer, and coordinate investigations, evidence handling, communications, escalation, reporting, and post-incident review; participate in the on-call incident response rotation.
Coordinate technical and third-party security work. Guide security architecture and engineering reviews across cloud and on-premises environments and technical security work spanning network, endpoint, vulnerability management, identity and access management, cloud, and application security; manage vendor security due diligence, assessments, contract and control reviews, and monitoring.
Coordinate assessment and penetration testing logistics while preserving assessor independence. Provide evidence, scheduling, and remediation ownership for the annual independent assessment and penetration test cycle without directing or influencing the independent assessors' scope, judgments, or findings.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, information technology, or engineering. In lieu of a degree, an equivalent combination of education, professional certification, and additional relevant experience will be considered.
12+ years of progressively responsible cybersecurity experience, including managing security programs, teams, or major security workstreams. (Note: eight years is the absolute floor for equivalency consideration; the posted target is 12+.)
Active CISSP or CISM certification.
Demonstrated experience managing security activities against the NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 control set in a complex enterprise environment.
Demonstrated experience owning a risk register and managing POA&Ms, findings, and corrective action plans through closure, using an enterprise GRC platform or comparable control-tracking system.
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor senior technical personnel while working collaboratively with client stakeholders, and to brief cybersecurity risk credibly to both technical and executive audiences in writing and in person.
US Citizenship and the abillity to pass a California criminal background clearance (Gov. Code
1043 / 10 CCR
6456) before starting work or accessing any confidential information, PII, PHI, federal tax information, or financial information.

Desired:

Master's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, or a related discipline.
PMP certification. CGRC, CRISC, or CCSP are also valued.
Hands-on experience with ARC-AMPE (ACA, Medicaid and Partner Entities) security and privacy requirements.
Experience with IRS Publication 1075 compliance and federal tax information (FTI) control management.
Experience with CMS cybersecurity requirements and the CMS Authority to Connect (ATC) process or comparable federal authorization processes.
Experience supporting healthcare eligibility and enrollment, Medicaid, or health insurance exchange systems of CalHEERS scale.
Experience supporting annual security and privacy assessments, including CMS Security Assessment Workbooks (SAWs), security assessment reports, POA&Ms, and control evidence packages.
Experience in California state government or comparable public-sector cybersecurity environments.

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:

in the United States to lead cross-functional operational strategy, scale internal systems, and manage critical programs across provider operations.

jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Oct 19, 2026

A typical day centers on keeping the Food Safety Audits programs running smoothly and the 3P auditor relationship healthy and productive. The Program Manager II leads the Worldwide Grocery Stores retail food safety audit program, partnering with a third party audit vendor, food safety analysts, store leadership, and cross functional stakeholders to ensure compliance with FDA Food Code.

Key job responsibilities

The role requires a results-oriented, analytical, customer-service approach to manage the audit program, measure progress, and drive risk management and compliance outcomes.

Manage the day-to-day execution of the Food Safety Audits programs, including the 3P Food Safety audit cycle — scheduling, coverage, standards alignment, and data integrity; works on one or more projects and may own a program.
Own accountability to the 3P Food Safety Auditor’s KPI scorecard; monitor audit completion, on-time delivery, scoring consistency, and finding-closure metrics, and act to keep them on target.
Manage the relationship with the 3P audit provider — align on audit standards and expectations, resolve data and scoring discrepancies, and hold the provider to KPI commitments.
Analyze and trend large audit data sets from internal and external audits to identify emerging Food Safety risks, recurring violations, and improvement opportunities.
Verify Food Safety policy and the FDA Food Code are correctly reflected in audit standards, checklists, and scoring criteria.
Support Food Safety escalations arising from audits; track corrective and preventive actions to closure with Operations stakeholders.
Optimize audit procedures, processes, and best practices to improve efficiency, data quality, and reporting cycle time.
Anticipate near-term bottlenecks in the audit program; identify, track, and mitigate immediate issues and risks, escalating when appropriate.
Write and publish audit performance and trend content for WWGS Business Reviews; convey findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
Collaborate with AMZ & WFM stakeholders to align audit processes with Food Safety policy and Operations needs.
Stay informed of FDA Food Code updates, regulatory publications, and industry audit benchmarks, and apply them to the audit program.
Begin to mentor peers and new team members on audit standards, data analysis, and the FDA Food Code.
Make trade-offs across time, quality, and resources to deliver reliable audit outcomes; decide when to resolve independently versus escalate.

A day in the life

Day-to-day Responsibilities Include

Data governance of internal and third-party audits for stores across the US, Canada, and UK
Data analysis to identify process gaps and resolution
Maintaining relevant metrics for a food safety scorecard that measures each store's food safety performance
Reviewing and resolving clarifications
Monitor vendor performance through a KPI scorecard
Ownership of food safety self-audit questions and data
Creation and publishing of monthly and ad-hoc content for food safety culture (Food Safety Empowerment Teams)

About The Team

The Retail Food Safety team supports stores and company facilities with Food Safety policy, mechanisms to efficiently embed Food Safety in store processes, and a means to measure compliance. We bridge Food Safety to cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Merchandising, Facilities, Procurement, and Leadership.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of program or project management experience
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
5+ years of managing food safety and quality in a large-scale retail or manufacturing environment experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Travel up to 25% of the time
CP-FS (Certified Professional – Food Safety) certification, or a comparable Food Safety professional certification.
Expertise in the FDA Food Code and retail food delivery/audit programs.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
5+ years of working directly with government officials and regulatory bodies experience

Nous, ce sont les femmes et les hommes de GGVie : près de 2 200 collaborateurs qui expérimentent, se serrent les coudes, s'écoutent et se donnent les moyens d'agir pour révolutionner le métier d'assureur.

Chez nous, on conçoit, souscrit et gère des contrats d'assurance vie et santé (épargne, retraite, prévoyance et santé). Ces derniers sont ensuite commercialisés par nos 5 réseaux de distribution : Caisses Régionales Groupama, Gan Assurances, Gan Patrimoine, Gan Prévoyance et Gan Eurocourtage.

Et vous dans tout ça ?

Nous le savons, les meilleures idées viennent de vous et nous sommes convaincus de la force du collectif ! Voilà pourquoi nous encourageons la prise d'initiatives, la remise en question et favorisons l'expérimentation.

Nous avons à cœur de vous donner le pouvoir pour que nous puissions, ensemble, viser haut et relever nos défis.

Envie de rejoindre la communauté #GGVie ? Votre belle histoire pourrait commencer ici ! 👇

Rejoignez la Direction des Collectives de Groupama Gan Vie (entité vie du Groupe Groupama) au sein du Département Digital et Solutions Métiers et de l'équipe MOA en charge des outils de traitement des flux de gestion déléguée.

Vous collaborerez avec un Product Owner et reporterez au responsable du pôle « SI Gestion des Contrats des Collectives ».

Au cœur des projets de transformation et d'optimisation des prestations déléguées, vous intervenez comme véritable interface entre les métiers et les équipes techniques.

Un poste transverse, riche en interactions, où vous aurez un rôle clé dans la modernisation des outils, l'optimisation des processus et l'accompagnement des transformations au service des utilisateurs.

Competitive Pay And Top Benefits, Including

401K

Health, Dental and Vision
Employer-paid STD, LTD, Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital, and Life Insurance

jobs.description:
About The Role

Muon seeks a Senior Technical Program Manager - Propulsion Systems to lead the end-to-end planning of the development, manufacturing and test of our propulsion systems.

This role may be worked remotely from an approved location.

Responsibilities

Mastering program schedules: You will own the full propulsion program roadmap. That means staying ahead of the curve across development, testing, parts procurement, and assembly, then mapping all of that into an active production flow while knowing exactly when hardware is "good enough" to move forward.
Bridging products and programs: You will serve as the primary link to our product group, helping guide strategic product decisions and making sure the overall roadmap gets executed without a hitch.
Driving thruster production: You will keep supply chains steady and kitting organized, track timeline needs for specific spacecraft missions, cut through organizational friction to keep production moving, and decide on pragmatic timing for introducing product upgrades.
Maintaining clear team communication: You will keep dialogue flowing across engineering leads, managers, and executives to minimize unexpected surprises or crossed wires.
Managing customer relationships: You will act as the point person for our thruster customers—understanding their pain points, sharing transparent updates, knowing when discretion is needed, and involving the broader propulsion engineering team only when required.
Translating needs into test priorities: You will break down top-level mission specs into clear testing targets, pinpointing exactly what must be proven on the test stand and building realistic plans to validate it.
Integrating across hardware teams: You will ensure propulsion works hand-in-hand with the rest of hardware—leveraging our machine shop, tapping mechanical engineering expertise, and coordinating sensible electrical integration efforts.
Advocating for the big picture: You will keep an eye on industry trends, competitor moves, and market shifts to help make tough choices that drive Muon's overall success.

Qualifications

5+ years working in engineering or program management environments.
A relevant degree in engineering, physical sciences, or a related technical field.
Proven track record navigating complex organization levels, balancing tight timelines, and resolving competing goals across different functional teams.

Nice-to-have Skills

Direct familiarity with space propulsion architectures and components.
Hands-on exposure to space systems development or spacecraft integration.
Practical work experience in test campaigns, hardware manufacturing, or production lines.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $206,000 - $232,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Pharma)
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Senior Project Manager (SPM) is responsible for leading projects from initiation through completion, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and on budget while consistently meeting or exceeding client and internal expectations. The SPM serves as a trusted client contact and strategic partner across Account Management, Creative, Strategy, and Production, driving seamless collaboration and high-quality execution across integrated marketing initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, adaptability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

The Senior Project Manager will be working EST timezone.

Key Responsibilities, Including But Not Limited To

Delivery Standards & Workflow Management

Lead and manage large-scale, complex projects including integrated campaigns, product launches, digital and print tactics, websites, email programs, social media initiatives, and multi-channel marketing efforts.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, scopes, budgets, forecasts, and resource allocations to support proactive execution and successful delivery.
Own project facilitation throughout the lifecycle, driving alignment, resolving ambiguity, and ensuring clear next steps across teams.
Manage the full project lifecycle, including project documentation, scopes of work, estimates, status reports, change orders, and budget reconciliation.
Monitor project health, identify risks and dependencies, escalate issues when necessary, and implement actionable solutions to maintain delivery timelines.
Ensure all projects adhere to agency standards, processes, and quality expectations.
Conduct internal and client-facing meetings, including kickoff meetings, status updates, project reviews, and working sessions.
Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting using project management tools such as Smartsheet, Hive, Workfront, SharePoint, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
Lead routing and review workflows across cross-functional teams, ensuring deliverables are assigned to the appropriate stakeholders, feedback is consolidated efficiently, approvals are secured on schedule, and final assets are delivered accurately and on time.
Track progress across projects, manage reporting updates, and oversee day-to-day project communications and deliverables.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Act as a trusted client contact for project communications, providing timely updates, setting clear expectations, and fostering strong client relationships.
Build and maintain trusted client partnerships through proactive communication, collaboration, and executional excellence.
Stay informed on client processes, procedures, and business needs, adapting communication and workflows accordingly.
Support project-related presentations, discussions, and strategic planning initiatives.
If and as needed, attend client meetings to track deliverables, align on priorities, and ensure deadlines and expectations are met.

Budget, Forecasting & Resource Management

Develop, manage, and reconcile project budgets from initiation through completion, ensuring accurate financial tracking and resource optimization.
Prepare estimates, support forecasting activities, and align project plans with evolving scope and business needs.
Partner with finance and department leadership on revenue reconciliation, staffing alignment, and budget management.
Manage finance and project health reviews, including burn reports and delivery risk assessments.
Ensure projects are appropriately staffed, scheduled, and resourced to support successful execution.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

Mentor, support, and provide guidance to Project Managers and Associate Project Managers and/or Project Coordinators, fostering professional development and project management best practices.
Support onboarding, training, and development initiatives for project management team members.
Serve as a collaborative leader across cross-functional teams, building trust, promoting accountability, and encouraging effective communication.
Adapt communication style based on audience and circumstances to drive alignment and productive collaboration.
Assist department leadership with workload management, team support, and quality oversight for deliverables.
Model professionalism, maturity, collaboration, and solution-oriented leadership across teams.
May manage direct reports.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Apply established processes, templates, and tools consistently across projects, ensuring alignment with departmental standards.
Act as a process champion and internal resource, supporting process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leadership.
Contribute to departmental initiatives, business development efforts, and agency-wide operational improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
Minimum 5+ years of project management experience within an integrated advertising, marketing, or digital agency environment.
Experience working with AOR Pharma Launch.
Proven ability to manage complex, integrated campaigns and large-scale initiatives across multiple channels.
Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
Skilled in project planning, facilitation, budgeting, forecasting, risk management, and issue resolution.
Experience managing project budgets and financial tracking processes.
Strong meeting facilitation and stakeholder management capabilities.
Collaborative, adaptable, and solution-oriented with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Experience with software development life cycles, digital production, creative workflows, and web technologies preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools such as Workfront, Smartsheet, Hive, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, or similar platforms.

The Program Manager brings structure and visibility to complex initiatives, manages timelines and dependencies, identifies risks and blockers, and facilitates effective communication across teams. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-paced product environment, managing multiple priorities, and bringing clarity to ambiguous or complex problems.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Operations, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
3–5 years of experience in program management, project management, product operations, product management, or a related field.
Experience working in a technology, software, or other product-driven environment.
Experience working in a regulated industry such as healthcare or financial services. Healthcare background is highly preferred.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Ability to influence and coordinate stakeholders without direct authority.
Proficiency with common project management, collaboration, and productivity tools.

Organization: Creates structure, maintains accurate documentation, and effectively manages competing priorities.
Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across Product and partner functions.
Communication: Clearly communicates status, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Problem Solving: Identifies issues and develops practical solutions.
Influence: Gains alignment and drives accountability without formal authority.
Adaptability: Effectively navigates changing priorities and ambiguity.
Product Orientation: Understands the connection between customer needs, product priorities, technology, and business outcomes.

What You Will Be Doing

Program Management

Manage the day-to-day execution of assigned product programs and initiatives.
Develop and maintain program plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
Coordinate activities across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and other stakeholder teams.
Track progress against commitments and proactively identify potential delays or issues.
Maintain clear documentation and visibility into program status.
Ensure action items, decisions, and follow-ups are clearly documented and completed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Product Managers and functional leads to coordinate execution of product initiatives.
Facilitate working sessions, planning meetings, status meetings, and project reviews.
Build alignment across teams with shared goals and interdependent deliverables.
Follow up on commitments and help teams resolve execution issues.
Serve as a central point of coordination for assigned programs.

Product Development & Launch

Support product initiatives across discovery, planning, development, testing, launch, and post-launch activities.
Coordinate launch readiness activities across relevant Product and business teams.
Track key launch dependencies and ensure outstanding items are identified and addressed.
Support development of launch plans, timelines, communications, and readiness checklists.
Help coordinate post-launch activities and follow-up actions.

Risk & Dependency Management

Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints that may affect program delivery.
Work with stakeholders to develop mitigation plans and resolve blockers.
Escalate significant issues when additional support or decision-making is required.
Maintain program-level risk and dependency tracking.
Provide timely visibility into changes that may impact scope, schedule, or deliverables.

Support Product leadership and Product Managers with planning materials, reporting, and operational processes.
Develop and maintain dashboards, status reports, and other program-management artifacts.
Identify opportunities to improve product planning and execution processes.
Contribute to the development and adoption of consistent Product operating practices.

Communicate changes to timelines, scope, risks, and dependencies in a timely manner.
Ensure stakeholders understand decisions, responsibilities, and next steps.

At Children’s, the region’s only full-service pediatric healthcare center, our people make us the very best for kids. A Brief Overview

Project Manager independently leads the delivery of moderate-complexity healthcare IT, clinical, and business initiatives, applying industry best practices to drive successful outcomes. This role is accountable for end-to-end project delivery, including collaborative planning and accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, communication, risk, and stakeholder engagement. Project Manager develops and manages integrated project plans, ensuring alignment with organizational goals related to patient care, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and strategic priorities. This role manages multiple projects concurrently and is responsible for delivering projects on time, within scope, and within budget. Working cross-functionally, the Project Manager leads project teams and influences stakeholders, including clinical leaders, operational partners, IT teams, vendors, and external partners. The role serves as the primary point of accountability for project performance and proactively addresses risks, issues, and dependencies. This position provides clear, timely, and actionable reporting to leadership and stakeholders, supporting informed decision-making and optimizing communication. Overall, this role demonstrates increasing independence, ownership, and accountability while delivering measurable project outcomes and contributing to organizational success.

Manage multiple projects concurrently.
Ensure alignment between project deliverables, organizational strategy, and healthcare operational priorities.

Demonstrate the ability to prioritize tasks, manage time, and be adaptable
Partner with departmental leadership to assess, prioritize, and balance project workloads based on organizational strategy and capacity.

BILL is looking for a tech-savvy Sr. Privacy Program Manager to help scale privacy operations across the Legal and Compliance team. This person will own key parts of BILL's privacy program and work closely with Product, Engineering, Information Security, CX and Procurement.

The Sr. Privacy Program Manager reports to the Director, Legal and helps set and carry out BILL's privacy strategy. They will own privacy impact assessments, data subject requests and vendor privacy reviews. They will also look for ways to make the program more efficient, including through smart use of automation and AI tools.

Own and scale core parts of BILL's privacy and data governance program.
Serve as the primary point of contact for privacy escalations, data subject requests, and privacy questions from across the company.
Own the DSAR program end to end, including intake, tracking, fulfillment, metrics and process improvements in partnership with CX.
Lead privacy impact assessments for new products, features and vendors that process personal data.
Run privacy reviews for AI features and internal AI tool adoption, working with Legal, InfoSec and Product.
Build and maintain data maps and records of processing, and stay current on company systems that hold personal data.
Develop and deliver privacy training for employees and specific teams.
Draft and maintain privacy policies, procedures and standard operating procedures.
Monitor changes to privacy laws and regulations (CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, GDPR and emerging AI rules) and explain what they mean for the business.
Find and roll out automation and AI tools that make privacy operations more efficient and scalable.
Track and report privacy program metrics to Legal leadership.

What You Bring

7+ years of experience in privacy, compliance or technology program management, including at least 4 to 5 years focused on privacy program operations (DSARs, PIAs/DPIAs, TIAs, ROPAs, vendor privacy reviews, cookie consent management, etc). Experience at a software, fintech or payments company preferred.
Working knowledge of CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, GLBA, GDPR, HIPAA.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, GC.ai or Harvey) in daily work, for example to draft documents, summarize regulations, review contracts, or speed up assessments and request workflows. Candidates should be ready to share specific examples.
Familiarity with privacy risks tied to AI, such as training data use, model inputs and outputs, and vendor AI terms, and experience assessing them.
Experience with privacy tech platforms (such as OneTrust, Transcend or TrustArc).
Ability to work with all levels of management, multiple geographies, subject matter experts, legal staff, vendors and customers.
Ability to pull together information from many sources and present it clearly and concisely.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Self-starter who spots issues and opportunities early and recommends actions.

Works well as part of a team.
Bachelor's degree.
CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM or CIPT certification preferred. JD a plus, not required.

Mayo Clinic is top-ranked in more specialties than any other care provider according to U.S. News & World Report. Responsibilities

The Senior Project Manager (PM) works independently, assuming primary responsibility for planning, directing, coordinating, and delivering project activities through the entire project life cycle (from initiation through handoff to customer) that are major, complex, and business critical. The Senior PM is responsible for leading project objectives and completion on time, on budget, and in conformance with Mayo Clinic project management methodologies and standards.

The Senior Project Manager serves as the portfolio execution leader for Pharmacy Intelligence & Automation. This role is responsible for coordinating and driving strategic initiatives involving pharmacy analytics, automation, artificial intelligence (AI), reporting, operational transformation, and technology optimization across Mayo Clinic pharmacy practice.

The position provides program leadership for a growing portfolio of initiatives and supports enterprise-wide deployment of innovative solutions that improve medication safety, operational efficiency, workforce productivity, regulatory compliance, and financial stewardship. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to manage a complex portfolio of strategic initiatives, work effectively with executive leaders and frontline staff, establish governance processes, translate strategy into execution, develop roadmaps and executive-level communications, track value realization and return on investment, lead organizational change efforts, and coordinate analytics, automation, AI, and innovation initiatives across pharmacy.

In addition to managing complex individual projects, this role provides oversight and coordination for an enterprise portfolio of strategic initiatives, ensuring work is appropriately prioritized, governed, resourced, measured, and successfully adopted.

The Senior PM will lead large projects that have site- or enterprise-level strategic importance. Project work has high to very high risk and risk interdependencies, multiple interrelationships, and may have major costs associated. Responsible for managing established budgets, the Senior PM leads and provides direction in the development and tracking of project budgets. The position requires strict adherence to budget management practices and guidelines of both the assigned department and the institution.

The Senior PM independently leads problem-solving and decision-making activities within the scope of the project and change management process, taking reasonable and prudent actions to accomplish agreed-upon project objectives. This individual leverages extensive experience to manage large-scale initiatives and is highly competent in the implementation and sustainment of project outcomes. Advanced negotiation skills, strategic thinking, and innovative problem-solving are essential to this role.

In addition to traditional project management responsibilities, this role is expected to support portfolio governance, strategic planning, executive reporting, stakeholder engagement, organizational change management, resource coordination, and benefits realization activities for enterprise pharmacy initiatives.

The use and application of Agile, Lean, and continuous improvement methodologies is important to this role. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading both technology-focused and operational transformation initiatives while adapting project approaches to meet organizational needs.

Many Of The Items Important To An Agile Process Are Not Unique To Agile. This Individual May Be Responsible For Monitoring Scrum Processes And Scrum Meetings. They May Work To Increase Efficiency, Motivate Teams, And Advocate For Changes That Ensure Quality And Timeliness. Responsibilities May Include:

Guiding teams on Agile practices and values to implement critical projects.
Assessing team and organizational maturity and coaching teams to higher levels of performance and effectiveness.
Removing impediments and blockers or guiding teams to do so; escalating appropriately when necessary.
Building a trusting and collaborative environment where issues can be openly raised and resolved.
Facilitating completion of work without coercion, assignment, or directive management approaches.
Facilitating discussion, decision making, and conflict resolution.
Supporting and educating Product Owners, particularly regarding backlog development and backlog refinement.

May have direct and indirect reports and may be responsible for leading and developing project staff in a goal-oriented manner. The Senior Project Manager leads and demonstrates a project-focused culture at Mayo Clinic and serves as a mentor and advisor to others regarding project management practices, methods, and standards.

This role will frequently interact with executive leaders, pharmacy operational leaders, informatics professionals, analysts, technology teams, and clinical stakeholders. Success requires strong executive communication skills, strategic thinking, influence without authority, and the ability to translate organizational priorities into executable plans while managing multiple concurrent initiatives.

Examples Of Work May Include:

Medication management reporting and business intelligence.
Pharmacy analytics and dashboard modernization.
Automation and workflow optimization initiatives.
AI and advanced analytics programs.
Epic-related pharmacy transformation efforts.
Drug shortage and inventory analytics.
Medication safety and diversion surveillance initiatives.
Operational excellence and continuous improvement programs.
Pharmacy technology and digital transformation initiatives.

Preferred Experience

Performs additional job-related functions as detailed by immediate supervisor.

Healthcare PMO leadership.
Enterprise digital transformation programs.
Clinical or pharmacy informatics.
Healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or data governance programs.
Operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
AI, automation, or emerging technology implementations.
Experience working with executive governance structures, steering committees, and enterprise portfolios.

This position is a hybrid role, and the candidate must live within 100 miles of Rochester, Minnesota.
On-site days will be purpose-driven and may include activities such as collaboration with colleagues, practice shadowing, and workflow observation. On-site requirements are estimated to be approximately two days per quarter.

This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship/ we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position. Also, Mayo Clinic DOES NOT participate in the F-1 STEM OPT extension program.

Bachelor's degree with 10 years’ experience in Project Management and business related activities or Master's degree with 7 years’ experience in Project Management. Education preference: project management, business administration, agile/scrum, management. Active (unexpired) Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required.

Description

The Work

ICF is seeking a Program Manager to lead integrated delivery for a modernization effort for the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation’s (FDIC). The program supports cloud data modernization, enterprise analytics and AI operations within FDIC’s governance and security environment.

You will provide the management structure that connects workstreams, technical teams, FDIC stakeholders, and delivery commitments. You will plan and sequence work, manage backlogs and sprint execution, monitor cost and schedule, control risks and changes, and ensure that work products are complete, traceable, secure, and ready for FDIC review and acceptance.

Job Location: Remote

What You Will Do

Lead program planning and execution across concurrent data, cloud, analytics, AI, and operations workstreams; maintain an integrated project plan and coordinate dependencies, milestones, and priorities.
Establish sprint plans with epics, backlog items, success criteria, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and sprint demonstrations; sequence work to support approved priorities and release objectives.
Manage the product backlog, requirements, code, artifacts, bug fixes, requirements baselines, system features, and business rules through FDIC GitHub Enterprise or approved tools.
Manage team and individual project budgets, track actual and projected costs, monitor burn rate, and provide cost projections and timely corrective actions.
Prepare weekly status reports covering cost, current and planned activities, schedule, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items; provide clear briefings to FDIC stakeholders.
Coordinate architecture, infrastructure, data, security, privacy, operations, and business stakeholder reviews; ensure decisions address cost, security, operations, technical standards, and mission requirements.
Manage requirements, risk, issue, change, and configuration processes, including FDIC Change Control Board and ServiceNow processes for production changes and configuration items.
Ensure deliverables and sprint outcomes meet acceptance criteria; coordinate quality reviews, continuous testing and validation, stakeholder feedback, and resolution of rework before submission.
Oversee security and compliance coordination, including A&A and ATO support, NIST 800-53 controls, POA&Ms, Azure policy findings, hardening guides, Security Impact Assessments, and annual security assessments.
Lead transition and continuity activities, including knowledge transfer, resource coordination, documentation handoff, communication channels, risk mitigation, and readiness for uninterrupted operations.

What You Will Bring With You

Demonstrated experience managing complex technology programs or projects with multiple technical workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Experience applying Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog management, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and work tracking through GitHub, Jira, or comparable tools.
Experience managing budgets, burn rates, schedules, risks, issues, action items, status reporting, and cost or schedule corrective actions.
Experience coordinating cloud, data, application, security, infrastructure, or analytics teams and translating technical issues and trade-offs for business and government stakeholders.

Ability to satisfy FDIC personnel eligibility and background-investigation requirements

Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

Experience supporting federal or regulated technology modernization programs, particularly cloud, data management, analytics, AI, or enterprise platform initiatives.
Experience with Azure, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure AI services, or comparable cloud technologies.
Experience supporting FDIC or similar governance bodies, including enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data governance, change control, A&A, ATO, or configuration management processes.
Experience developing project, risk, requirements, security, architecture, data, testing, UAT, and transition documentation.
Experience using GitHub Enterprise, ServiceNow, Jira, Power BI, Azure Monitor, or comparable delivery and reporting tools.
Experience establishing KPIs, agile metrics, quality measures, stakeholder feedback loops, and QASP-style performance reporting.
Experience leading transition-in or transition-out activities, incumbent knowledge transfer, operational readiness, or continuity planning.
PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, ITIL, or comparable project or Agile certification.

Professional Skills

Lead with clarity and accountability across technical teams, government stakeholders, and partner organizations.
Communicate status, risks, decisions, and recommendations concisely to both executive and working-level audiences.
Organize complex work into actionable plans with clear ownership, sequencing, and follow-through.

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. Deel est la plateforme tout-en-un de paie et de RH dédiée aux équipes internationales. Notre vision est de donner à chaque individu, équipe et entreprise accès aux opportunités mondiales. About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Technical Program Manager
to join our Technical Program Management team. This role is hybrid
based in Palo Alto
. We are looking for a high-leverage, outcome-oriented Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Technical Program Management organization. Continuously inspect, refine, and modernize the PDP lifecycle (phase gates, design reviews, launch readiness, post-mortems) to eliminate friction and ensure processes stay lean and effective.
Define and track key operational metrics (e.g., cycle times, release velocity, defect escape rates) to measure PDP health and drive continuous improvements.

What You’ll Need:

Experience: 12+ years of technical program management experience, with a proven track record operating at executive level visibility in high-growth, technically complex environments.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience operating in regulated, mission-critical, or hardware-software integrated product environments.
Ability to establish operational standards and drive compliance through partnership and trust rather than bureaucratic mandates.
Background in developing internal tooling, dashboards, and automated workflows to track governance and engineering velocity.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to distill deep technical trade-offs into actionable insights for VP and C-suite stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager I, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

In this role, you will drive the delivery of our most complex, high-value enterprise implementations, setting the standard for client engagement, project governance, and operational excellence. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and a strategic partner across Product, Engineering, and Operations, while shaping the playbooks and practices that define how the team delivers.

Responsibilities

Leading and overseeing end-to-end implementation projects for the most complex, high-value enterprise clients, including executive-level client relationship management, project governance, steering committee facilitation, and multi-stakeholder communications.
Owning and growing a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts with the most sophisticated onboarding requirements, setting the standard for project plans, milestones, and deliverables across the team.
Independently designing and tailoring the project approach to each client’s context, setting the benchmark for professional judgment and client-specific delivery excellence across the organisation.
Proactively leading risk identification, assessment, and mitigation across the portfolio, anticipating issues that could impact onboarding timelines, scope, or client satisfaction, and advising leadership on escalations and resolutions.
Shaping product and operational feedback loops, and driving strategic partnerships with Product, Engineering, and Operations to influence roadmap priorities.
Leading the development and continuous improvement of team processes, playbooks, and best practices, elevating the overall performance of the onboarding function.

Qualifications

5+ years in an implementation role supporting a B2B SaaS product, particularly in HR, Payroll, and Finance domains.
Demonstrated ability to build strong customer relationships and a passion for teaching others, whether a customer or a colleague.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks. You are focused, action-oriented, and always anticipating the next steps.
Ability to clearly convey complex ideas and data in written, presentation, and verbal formats to customers and team members.
High attention to detail with the capability to design organized and effective onboarding plans and schedules for clients.
Driven, quick-thinking, and thrive in a fast-paced, challenging environment. You excel in an autonomous work setting, expertly prioritizing tasks and identifying internal and external blockers.

Application Deadline for U.S. Applicants:
Recruiting timelines vary by position, however, all Deel positions accept applications for a minimum of 5 days from the posting date listed herein. This position is open and still accepting applications

Benefits
: Full-time employees in the United States receive a variety of benefits while employed at Deel.

Health Insurance Effective from Day 1 (Medical, Dental, & Vision)
401k Retirement Plan
Disability Insurance
Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Flexible Savings Account (FSA)
Flexible time off (PTO)
12 paid holidays per year
Parental leave: 16 weeks for the birthing parent and 8 weeks for the non-birthing parent

Ce que nous faisons définit qui nous sommes.

Deel est la plateforme tout-en-un de paie et de RH dédiée aux équipes internationales. Notre vision est de donner à chaque individu, équipe et entreprise accès aux opportunités mondiales. Conçue pour répondre aux modes de travail actuels, Deel regroupe le SIRH, la paie, la conformité légale, les avantages sociaux, la performance et la gestion des équipements au sein d'une interface unique et fluide. Grâce à des outils propulsés par l'IA et une infrastructure de paie interne, Deel accompagne tous les types de travailleurs dans plus de 150 pays, aidant ainsi les entreprises à se développer de manière plus intelligente, plus rapide et plus conforme.

Comptant parmi les plus grandes entreprises au monde, notre équipe de 7 000 collaborateurs s'étend sur plus de 100 pays, parle 74 langues et porte une culture connectée et dynamique qui favorise l'apprentissage continu et l'innovation pour nos clients.

Pourquoi devriez-vous prendre part à notre succès ?

En tant qu'entreprise de Logiciel en tant que Service (SaaS) à la croissance la plus rapide de l'histoire, Deel transforme la manière dont les talents mondiaux se connectent aux entreprises de premier plan ; brisant les frontières qui limitent traditionnellement l'embauche et les opportunités de carrière. Nous ne nous contentons pas de créer un logiciel ; nous bâtissons l'infrastructure du futur du travail, favorisant une économie mondiale plus diverse et inclusive. En 2024 seulement, nous avons versé 11,2 milliards de dollars à des travailleurs dans près de 100 devises et fournit une couverture santé et des avantages sociaux dans 109 pays, garantissant que chacun soit rémunéré et protégé, peu importe où il se trouve.

Notre élan se reflète dans nos réussites et la satisfaction de nos clients : CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, ainsi qu'une reconnaissance répétée dans la liste des meilleures entreprises de Y Combinator, tout en maintenant une note moyenne de 4,83 basée sur 15 000 avis via G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple et Google.

Votre expérience chez Deel sera un véritable accélérateur de carrière. À l'avant-garde de la révolution mondiale du travail, vous relèverez des défis complexes qui impactent la vie professionnelle de millions de personnes. Porté par notre dynamique, soutenue par une valorisation de 17,3 milliards de dollars et un revenu annuel récurrent (ARR) d'un milliard de dollars en un peu plus de cinq ans, vous générerez un impact significatif tout en développant une expertise qui fera de vous un leader convoité de la transformation du travail à l'échelle mondiale.

Résumé

Dans ce rôle, vous piloterez la livraison des mises en œuvre d'entreprise les plus complexes de Deel. Vous serez responsable de 4 à 6 comptes parmi les plus importants tout au long de leur transformation. Vous gérerez des clients exigeants répartis dans plusieurs territoires, dirigerez des comités directeurs composés de membres de la haute direction et établirez la norme d'excellence en matière de livraison. Ce rôle exige une expertise approfondie des services de paie mondiaux et des services d'employeur officiel (EoR), une solide expérience de la gestion de clients de haut niveau ainsi que la capacité de concevoir des stratégies sur mesure pour des mises en œuvre complexes dans plusieurs pays.

Responsabilités

Diriger des mises en œuvre d'entreprise de 6 à 18 mois avec des parties prenantes de la haute direction et concevoir des approches de projet sur mesure
Gérer les comités directeurs, la livraison de plusieurs volets de travail et la coordination interfonctionnelle
Gérer les configurations de paie dans plusieurs pays, la conformité fiscale, l'architecture des avantages sociaux et la réglementation locale
Diriger la migration de données pour de grandes bases de données d'employés et concevoir les intégrations avec les systèmes RH et financiers
Superviser les flux de travail de conformité EoR, les déclarations réglementaires et les configurations complexes
Repérer et atténuer les risques de façon proactive et procéder aux escalades de manière stratégique
Agir à titre de conseiller de confiance et élaborer des plans détaillés comprenant des jalons et des critères de réussite propres à chaque client
Faire des présentations à la haute direction et gérer les attentes tout au long des phases de planification
Repérer les occasions d'expansion (nouveaux pays, modules supplémentaires) et les transmettre aux directeurs de comptes
Collaborer avec les équipes Produit et Ingénierie pour leur faire part des constats du terrain et influencer les priorités de la feuille de route
Collaborer avec les équipes Conformité, Finances et Opérations, et encadrer les gestionnaires de projet juniors
Diriger l'élaboration de guides de pratiques, normaliser les approches et rehausser les compétences de l'équipe

Qualifications

Plus de 7 ans d'expérience en mise en œuvre d'entreprise, en gestion de projet ou en livraison (expérience en technologies RH, en paie ou en mobilité internationale, un atout)
Expérience démontrée : au moins 3 mises en œuvre dans plusieurs pays, couvrant 5 territoires ou plus, ou plus de 1 000 employés
Réussite dans la gestion de comptes générant plus de 5 M$ en revenus annuels récurrents, avec un excellent taux de satisfaction client et des résultats de livraison solides
Expérience avec des plateformes de paie (Workday, Ceridian, BambooHR) ou des solutions EoR ou de mobilité internationale

Rémunération Globale

Nos collaborateurs méritent une rémunération juste et compétitive qui s'adapte à leur réalité. Avec des avantages sociaux et des gratifications évolutives, notre programme de rémunération globale reflète notre engagement en faveur de l'inclusion et de l'accessibilité pour tous.

Ce Dont Vous Bénéficierez

Des opportunités d'attribution d'actions (stock options) selon votre rôle, votre statut d'emploi et votre localisation.
Des avantages et privilèges supplémentaires basés sur votre statut d'emploi et votre pays.
La flexibilité du travail à distance, incluant un accès optionnel aux espaces WeWork.

Égalité des chances et Diversité

Chez Deel, nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité et encourageons vivement les candidatures de personnes qualifiées, sans distinction de race, de religion, de sexe, d'origine nationale, d'identité de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, d'âge, d'état civil, de statut de vétéran, de handicap, de grossesse ou de maternité, ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Major Projects
jobs.description:
Spark Power Corp USA is seeking an experienced Program Manager, Major Projects
who will be accountable for the successful end-to-end delivery of large and complex programs and projects, spanning both high voltage and low voltage electrical infrastructure work. This role provides senior project leadership across the full project lifecycle – from initial scoping and estimating through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout – for programs that may include multiple concurrent projects, sites, contractors, and internal delivery teams.

Our ideal Program Manager, Major Projects
candidate will be the single point of accountability for assigned programs, the Program Manager, Major Projects leads cross-functional and often cross-regional teams, manages client and stakeholder relationships at a senior level, and ensures that safety, quality, schedule, and financial targets are met or exceeded. This position blends the technical rigor of a traditional high voltage/low voltage Project Manager with the broader coordination, governance, and reporting responsibilities required to run programs at scale

What
will you do in this position?

Program & Project Leadership
Serve as the single point of accountability for the successful delivery of assigned major projects and programs, spanning high voltage and low voltage electrical scopes.
Lead project teams (internal staff, subcontractors, and vendors) through all phases of the project lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/control, and closeout.
Where a program includes multiple linked projects, provide overall program governance – coordinating scope, schedule, and resource interdependencies across individual project managers and workstreams.
Identify and pursue opportunities for account growth and follow-on work within existing client programs.

Team Leadership & Resource Management
Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, engineers, coordinators, and site supervisors assigned to the program, fostering a high-performance and safety-first culture.
Coordinate with resource/branch managers to secure the labour, equipment, and materials needed to meet project commitments.
Set clear expectations, provide regular performance feedback, and support the professional development of project team members.

Risk Management & Reporting
Identify, assess, and mitigate project and program risks (technical, commercial, safety, schedule) throughout the project lifecycle.
Maintain accurate project documentation, including status reports, risk registers, meeting minutes, and lessons-learned records.
Provide timely, accurate reporting to senior leadership on program health, financial performance, and key risks/issues.

Do you have the Spark
? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered.
5+ years of progressive project/program management experience delivering electrical infrastructure projects, with direct experience in both high voltage (>800V) and low voltage systems.
Demonstrated success managing large-scale, multi-site, or multi-year programs, including projects with total installed value in the multi-million-dollar range.
Prior experience in substation construction, utility/industrial electrical projects, renewable energy (solar/wind/BESS), or comparable heavy electrical infrastructure work is strongly preferred.
Experience managing subcontractors, EPC-style delivery, and client-facing commercial relationships.
Professional Engineering designation (P.Eng. in Canada or PE in the U.S.), or active pursuit of licensure, is strongly preferred.
Candidates holding a Red Seal/journeyman certification as an Electrician or Powerline Technician, combined with equivalent field leadership and project delivery experience, are equally encouraged to apply and will be given strong consideration in lieu of a P.Eng./PE designation.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or working toward one, preferred.
Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as required.
Additional relevant safety certifications (e.g., NFPA 70E, First Aid/CPR) are an asset.

Working Conditions

Combination of office-based work and regular travel to active project and client sites (estimated 25–50%, varying by program phase).
May require site visits to active construction, substation, or utility environments; adherence to all site-specific PPE and safety requirements is mandatory.
Occasional evening/weekend availability may be required to support critical project milestones, outages, or commissioning events.
Valid passport and ability to travel across Canada and/or the United States, as applicable to assigned programs

Here Are Some Of The Perks Spark Employees Enjoy

Diverse and exciting industrial, commercial and institutional projects and customer base
Growing company with consistent work
Continuous training and skills improvement
Career advancement opportunities
Competitive wages
Travel opportunities
Excellent benefit package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Extended Health, Disability)
401k with percentage company match
Paid uniforms
Paid tooling
Great company culture!
….and much more

Who is Spark
Power
?

Spark Power is the leading independent provider of end-to-end electrical services and operations and maintenance services to the industrial, utility, and renewable asset markets in North America. We work to earn the right to be our customers’ Trusted Partner in Power™. Our highly skilled and dedicated people, located in the communities we serve, combined with our knowledge of the power industry, technology expertise, and commitment to safety, ensures we deliver the right solutions that keep our customers’ operations up and running today and better equipped for tomorrow.
